# Invalid mathematical documentation

Bare dollar math: $x_i$.
Dollar math inside code: `$x_i$`.
One-sided leading delimiter: `$`x_i`$.
One-sided trailing delimiter: $`x_i`$`.
Bare Unicode formula: x ≤ y.
Bare complexity: O(n).
Old display delimiter: $$x+y$$.
Unicode inside MathJax: $`x ≤ y`$.
Letter-abutting opener: x$`y`$.
